text:
hana.docs: holding PR #4412 (idempotency + retry guidance) until infra/runtime confirms a couple of low-level details we need to state exactly in the migration guide and API reference. preview showed wording that might be interpreted as "server retries streaming calls" which is wrong. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4412
ci-bot: docs-preview: failed  snapshot mismatch on /api-reference/retries (build 947) :warning:
peter.runtime: can you paste the exact sentence that failed? i want to address it directly.
hana.docs: line in question: "The platform will transparently retry failed generate calls when safe to do so." readers took that to mean streaming endpoints get retried. minimal repro we document is just the curl example for streaming.
lila.sdk: SDK note: client libs expose `idempotency_key` and `retry_policy`. defaults: streaming calls have no automatic client retries; non-streaming calls in SDK may perform client-side retries if configured. we need to call out server-side behavior separately.
tom.qe: confirmed in tests: server only retries non-streaming requests and only when an idempotency_key is present. streaming connections are never retried server-side. i can paste failing test logs if helpful.
peter.runtime: authoritative behavior (please copy this wording into the docs): "Server-side retries are supported only for non-streaming generate calls when the request includes an `idempotency_key`. The server dedupes requests with the same idempotency_key for 30 seconds and may return a previously-completed response instead of re-running the model. Streaming requests are considered non-idempotent and are not retried by the platform."
hana.docs: perfect. two small follow-ups for the doc text: (1) what's the allowed format/length for `idempotency_key`? (2) does the server echo the key back in responses/headers so clients can correlate?
peter.runtime: good catches. specifics: (a) idempotency_key is an opaque UTF-8 string up to 128 characters; we sanitize whitespace and reject null bytes. (b) server echoes it in a response header `X-Idempotency-Key` for non-streaming responses and includes it in the JSON response body under `meta.idempotency_key` when returning from cache. (we don't add the header for streamed SSE responses because streaming isn't retried).
lila.sdk: SDK will document the 128-char limit and show examples for setting the key. we'll add helper utilities in the SDK migration guide (e.g., `generateIdempotencyKey(userId, timestamp)`) and a snippet to pass through headers.
tom.qe: extra test detail: dedupe window is 30s by default across a single region; dedupe is strongly consistent within a region but may be eventual across cross-region routing. recommend docs advise clients to avoid relying on cross-region dedupe.
hana.docs: ok will add sentence: "Dedupe window: 30 seconds per region; cross-region dedupe is not guaranteed."
ops-bot: note from infra: there is also an admin-configurable `idempotency_window_ms` for Dedicated installs (default 30000). include that callout under Dedicated configuration.
peter.runtime: also call out error behavior: if a non-streaming attempt fails and retries are exhausted the server returns the final 5xx to the client; if dedupe returns a cached result we return 200 with `X-Idempotency-Key` header.
hana.docs: i'll update PR text to: (1) replace ambiguous sentence with peter's authoritative paragraph, (2) add idempotency key format/length, (3) include header/body echoing behavior, (4) add the 30s dedupe note and Dedicated config flag, (5) call out streaming = not retried. then i'll push and trigger preview. holding merge until ci passes and one approval from @lila.sdk and @peter.runtime.
ci-bot: docs-preview: rebuild requested for PR 4412 (build 948)
ci-bot: docs-preview: success (build 948) :tada:
lila.sdk: LGTM from SDK docs POV. small nit in examples but not blocking.
peter.runtime: approved. wording nit fixed.
hana.docs: merging after squash. thanks all for quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:
